# Design System

Sydeso's visual direction is minimal, futuristic, developer-focused, and tightly structured.

Canonical docs:

- `docs/brand/visual-branding-guide.md`
- `docs/prds/design-system-governance.md`

Design rules:

- App UI font: Inter
- Marketing headings: Funnel Display
- Marketing body: Kanit
- Small radius: 5-10px maximum by default
- UI changes must include screenshots and design-lock references
